Companies Act
(Chapter 50, Section 27(1)(d))
Directions under Section 27 (1) (d) — Consolidation
Dir 1
G.N. No. S 265/1991
REVISED EDITION 2005
(31st March 2005)
The Minister for Finance has directed that the Registrar of Companies shall not accept for registration under the Act —
(a)the word “Temasek” in any company name unless the company or proposed company is a related corporation, as defined in section 4(1) of the Act, of Temasek Holdings (Pte.) Ltd. (Registration No. 197401143C);
[S 265/91]
(b)(Deleted by S 257/2008 wef 16/05/2008.)
(c)(Deleted by S 257/2008 wef 16/05/2008.)
